name: Main and check tariff meters
description: Main and check tariff meters for the 7-unit gas-engine generator plant and SESB 132/33/11 kV connection. Procurement / I&C. BOQ quantities and dimensions are design inputs, not sourced facts. Primary source: https://ecos.gov.my/sites/default/files/uploads/para/attachments/2024-01/Sabah%20Grid%20Code.pdf

specifications.metric: SESB revenue metering installation - M — metering configuration
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code clause MC4.1.1 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Revenue Metering shall comprise of a Main Meter to measure and record the required data and a Check Meter to validate the readings from the Main Meter as back-up metering at all Connection Points.' (value: Main Meter plus Check Meter at all Connection Points; Check Meter validates Main)

specifications.metric: SESB revenue metering installation - M — maximum allowable overall error - active / reactive, Type 1 (>7.5 MW or 60 GWh per annum)
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code Metering Code Appendix 1, Table 1 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): row 'More than 7.5MW or 60GWh per annum 0.6 1.0 ...' under 'Maximum Allowable Overall Error (±%) ... Active Reactive'.

specifications.metric: SESB revenue metering installation - M — minimum component classes and burdens, Type 1 (printed table row)
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code Metering Code Appendix 1, Table 1 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): exact printed row reproduced as value; the table layout in the fetched text does not unambiguously separate all class columns, so values are retained as printed rather than reinterpreted. (value: 0.2 CT Burden 30 VA if ../1A, 15 VA if ../5A, 0.2 VT Min Burden 100VA, 0.2 Wh Me)

specifications.metric: SESB revenue metering installation - M — meter clock error reference
specifications.unit: ±5 ppm relative to Malaysian Standard Time
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code Metering Code Appendix 1, Table 1 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Meter Clock Error (Seconds) with Reference to Malaysian Standard Time ... ±5ppm'; MC9 adds 'The Metering Database must be set within an accuracy of ±1 second of Malaysian Standard Time'.

specifications.metric: SESB revenue metering installation - M — energy registration resolution 0.5S / 0.2S meters
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code clause MCA.1.5 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'the resolution of the energy registration of 0.5S class Meters shall be better than 0.2 % and the resolution of the energy registration of 0.2S class Meters shall be better than 0.1 %'.

specifications.metric: SESB revenue metering installation - M — check metering requirement by annual energy
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code clause MCA.1.4 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Check Metering shall be applied in accordance with the following Table: 1 Larger than 60GWh Check Metering Installation; 2 Less than 60GWh Check Metering'. (value: Larger than 60GWh: Check Metering Installation; Less than 60GWh: Check Metering)

specifications.metric: SESB revenue metering installation - M — check metering installation arrangement
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code clause MCA.1.4 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'A Check Metering Installation shall include the provision of a separate Metering Installation using separate current transformer cores and separate secondary windings. The accuracy of Check Metering Installation shall be the same as the Main Metering Installation.' (value: separate Metering Installation using separate current transformer cores and sepa)

specifications.metric: SESB revenue metering installation - M — metering installation component scope
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code clause MC4.2 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): list of items each Metering Installation shall consist of. (value: Meters and data loggers; CT and VT; secure protected wiring; meter panel; commun)

specifications.metric: SESB revenue metering installation - M — communicating link availability target
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code clause MC6.1 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'target availability of the communication link shall be 95% per annum unless otherwise agreed'.

specifications.metric: SESB revenue metering installation - M — laboratory testing uncertainty, Class 0.2 CT/VT and Wh meter
specifications.basis: Sabah Grid Code Metering Code Appendix 2 (published 2024, read via r.jina.ai): 'Class 0.2 CT / VT ± 0.05% Class 0.2 Wh Meters ± (0.05/cos θ)%'. (value: ±0.05% for Class 0.2 CT/VT; ±(0.05/cos θ)% for Class 0.2 Wh meters)

specifications.metric: Itron ACE SL7000 industrial & substati — transformer-connected accuracy class
specifications.basis: Itron ACE SL7000 datasheet EL.0019.1-EN-02/12, © Copyright 2012 Itron, PDF read via r.jina.ai: 'Transformer Connected: Class 0.2S, Class 0.5S or Class C'. (value: Class 0.2S, Class 0.5S or Class C)

specifications.metric: Itron ACE SL7000 industrial & substati — standards compliance
specifications.basis: Itron ACE SL7000 datasheet EL.0019.1-EN-02/12 (© 2012 Itron), read via r.jina.ai: 'Full compliance with IEC 62052, IEC 62053, MID standard EN50470-1 and EN50470-3 and CE marking standards'. (value: IEC 62052, IEC 62053, EN50470-1, EN50470-3, CE)

specifications.basis: Itron ACE SL7000 datasheet (© 2012 Itron), read via r.jina.ai: 'Storage of up to 16 channels for various quantities in two independent banks'.

specifications.metric: Itron ACE SL7000 industrial & substati — CT connection rating
specifications.basis: Itron ACE SL7000 datasheet (© 2012 Itron), read via r.jina.ai: 'CT Connection: Ib 1A, Imax 10A'. (value: Ib 1A, Imax 10A)

Landis+Gyr E850 product page (© Landis+Gyr 2026), read directly: '4-quadrant measurement' and 'CT/VT error correction' listed under features/variations. (value: 4-quadrant (+P -P, +Q -Q, Q1..Q4); CT/VT error correction; instantaneous phase v)
